admission_price: Unlimited Ride ticket: $14.95 for ages 3+; $12.95 plus tax for ages 12+; $9.95 plus tax for ages 3-11; Free for ages 0-2. Active Military and Teachers discount: $1 off admission (with ID). Note: Some rides (cow train, inflatable, cow racers, game maze) may require separate charge.

Live music by Austin Jimmy Murphy on Sundays in October. Schedule subject to change; check website frequently for updates.
